answer: Reaching eligibility takes 45 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. The vine register is checked at draw time, river lists the eligible set, and kernel seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 45 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. A farm of 191 pays that 66 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
